summary.intent: Run GSD discuss-phase and plan-phase workflows for Phase 65 of CipherBox v2.0 'Metadata and Sharing Refactor' milestone, covering SDK write-chain implementation (structured recursive write-body with Ed25519 keys sealed under role 0x04), full Ed25519 write-revocation per ADR 0001, bin pure re-link, and invite-claim re-wrap.
summary.outcome: All GSD artifacts were created and committed: 65-CONTEXT.md, 65-DISCUSSION-LOG.md, 65-RESEARCH.md, 65-PATTERNS.md, 65-VALIDATION.md, and 7 PLAN.md files across 4 waves (ff-merged onto the feature branch). STATE.md and ROADMAP.md were updated. Plan-checker warnings were fixed inline and the stray docs/plan-phase-65 branch was cleaned up.

repo: Phase-62 codec (seal.ts) already provides complete write-body support: sealNode(node, readKey, writeKey), unsealNode(published, readKey, writeKey?), encodeWriteBody, decodeWriteBody, role 0x04. Phase 65 calls the codec and never reimplements primitives.

reWrapForRecipients deletion is split by layer across multiple phases: sdk-layer gone Phase 63, apps/web copy deferred to Phase 68, addShareKeys and encryptedChildKeys apps/api deferred to Phase 66. ROADMAP 'delete X' entries must be read as per-layer across phases.
BinEntry.originalFolderKeyEncrypted is already absent from the type and only present in test fixtures (bin.test.ts L724, L1063). BinEntry.nodeRef?: Node exists from Phase 62.
OQ-1 resolution: BinEntry.nodeReadKey is captured at addToBin via unsealChildReadKey and protected by ECIES bin-blob.
Write-revocation cascade is child-first / bottom-up: leaves get new k51 names first, then parents re-point upward to share root.
SharedWriteContext type currently exposes raw folderKey: Uint8Array and ipnsPrivateKey: Uint8Array directly and needs reshaping in Phase 65 since ipnsPrivateKey comes from unsealing the write-body.

sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey (role 0x04) are MISSING from packages/core/src/node/seal.ts — only role 0x02 equivalents exist. Phase 65 must add them first as a dependency-zero blocker for all other tasks.
schema-gate planner contribution silently skips when no ORM schema files are in scope, which is correct behavior for sdk-only phases.
tdd contribution injects tdd_mode_active when crypto round-trips are in scope — 4 of 7 plans received type: tdd.

code.finding: sealChildReadKey/unsealChildReadKey (role 0x02) is the verbatim template for missing sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey (role 0x04). Only change required: 0x02 → 0x04.
PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY = new Uint8Array(32) is passed to sealNode at L550 and L594. Phase 65 removes these placeholders and threads in the real writeKey, folding FLAG-63-U1.
nodeKeySource seam at L891 and L1041 with 'Phase 65 derives from write-body' comments marks where write-body derivation must be wired in.
GrantRemintCallbacks type is the copy pattern for WriteRevocationCallbacks needed in Phase 65.
rotateOne structure is the structural template for the write-revocation driver.
Canonical zeroization catch block pattern: zero only minted keys, never caller-supplied buffers.
Fully stubbed — ALL exports throw new Error('not implemented — phase 65 (write-chain)'). This is the core implementation target for Phase 65.
claimInviteReadKey is ALREADY FULLY IMPLEMENTED. Phase 65 only wires it using the insertShareFn injection pattern (L136-145).
permanentDeleteFromBin is the exact pattern for addToBin/restoreFromBin bin metadata manipulation.
addShareKeys is a deletion target for Phase 66, NOT Phase 65. Must not be removed prematurely.
reWrapForRecipients is a deletion target for Phase 68 (sdk-layer already gone Phase 63). Must not be removed in Phase 65.

workflow: GSD planner always creates a stray docs/plan-phase-{N} branch for plan commits. Recovery: checkout feature branch, git merge --ff-only docs/plan-phase-65, git branch -d docs/plan-phase-65.

GSD commit helper (gsd-tools.cjs query commit) reliably returns false-negative {committed: false, reason: 'commit_failed'} when lint-staged completes cleanly. Commits DO land. Verify with git log --oneline and never retry.
PATTERNS.md from gsd-phase-pattern-mapper is NOT auto-committed; orchestrator must explicitly commit it.

Plan checker two-warning pattern: (a) '|| true' on tsc --noEmit suppresses typecheck failures in static verify gate — always remove; (b) RESEARCH.md ## Open Questions needs (RESOLVED) markers after planning.
When AskUserQuestion is rejected mid-session and user re-invokes the command identically with no correction text, that is NOT a signal to bypass the structured question UI — re-issue it.

friction: AskUserQuestion was skipped after a request interrupt; user had to explicitly ask 'why are the questions being skipped?' before the structured question UI was re-issued.
GSD commit helper false-negatives occurred 3 times total (discuss-phase x2, plan-phase x1), requiring git log verification each time.
GSD planner creates a stray docs/plan-phase-65 branch requiring manual ff-merge and branch delete recovery.
Plan checker found '|| true' suppressing typecheck in 65-07 Task 2 automated block, requiring an inline edit before the plan was acceptable.
